text: dsh-lan-access（DSH 插件，Web 客户端）：让 DSH Web GUI 可在局域网内访问，并兼容纯 HTTP 页面。它通过 bundle patch 将 Web 服务器绑定到所有网络接口，并向页面注入 crypto.randomUUID polyfill。插件还为设置、凭据、agent preset、主机操作和模型发现等特权 API 注册精确路由，将请求转交 DSH API 代理。适合需要从局域网其他设备访问 DSH 网页界面的用户；无需 API Key 或外部账号。

dsh-lan-access (DSH Web plugin): Lets LAN devices reach the DSH GUI by binding the server to all interfaces. It adds a crypto.randomUUID polyfill for plain HTTP and routes selected settings, credentials, host, agent preset, and model APIs. No API key or external account is needed.
想从家里另一台设备打开 DSH 的网页界面
让局域网里的手机也能访问电脑上运行的 DSH
DSH 网页在 HTTP 局域网地址下不能正常工作怎么办

怎样让平板访问本机启动的 DSH Web GUI
How can I open my DSH web interface from another device on my LAN?
Make the DSH GUI work when accessed over plain HTTP on a local network.
dsh-lan-access 的功能「局域网 Web 访问」：安装 bundle patch 后，DSH Web 服务器绑定到 0.0.0.0，使局域网内其他设备能够打开 Web GUI；端口仍沿用 DSH 启动时的端口设置。
dsh-lan-access 的功能「纯 HTTP 页面兼容」：插件在 Web 页面 head 开始处注入 crypto.randomUUID polyfill，让以纯 HTTP 局域网源打开的 GUI 可使用该 UUID API。
dsh-lan-access 的功能「局域网特权 API 路由」：插件为设置、凭据、agent preset、主机操作和模型发现方法注册精确 /api 路由，并将请求交给 DSH API 代理处理。
I need to use DSH from a computer elsewhere in my home network.

[中文](README.zh.md) | English

Bind the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH) Web GUI to `0.0.0.0` so other machines on the LAN can reach it — plus a `crypto.randomUUID` polyfill that makes the GUI fully work over plain-HTTP LAN origins — **without modifying any shipped dsh code**.

@woyeshishen/dsh-lan-access README · Features：| | |
| --- | --- |
| 🌐 **LAN access** | Rebind the Web GUI to `0.0.0.0` via an id-targeted config patch. No `--host` flag involved, so the built-in `0.0.0.0` guard never runs |
| 🛡️ **`crypto.randomUUID` polyfill** | Injects a tiny script into `index.html` so `/api` RPCs work on non-secure HTTP origins (the Web API is undefined there) |
| 🔓 **Remote privileged methods** | Settings / credentials / agent presets work from the LAN too (`allowRemotePrivileged`, default on) |
| 📦 **Install once, keep working** | Static bundle auto-mounts into the profile and loads at DSH startup, survives restarts |

@woyeshishen/dsh-lan-access README · One-liner (recommended)：**Windows (PowerShell)**

```powershell
irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/woyeshishen/dsh-lan-access/main/scripts/install.ps1 | iex
```

**macOS / Linux**

```sh
bash <(curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/woyeshishen/dsh-lan-access/main/scripts/install.sh)
```

@woyeshishen/dsh-lan-access README · dsh plugin command：**From npm**

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add @woyeshishen/dsh-lan-access
```

**From GitHub**

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:woyeshishen/dsh-lan-access
```

After install, the plugin auto-mounts into the profile; restart DSH (or hot-reload) to activate.

@woyeshishen/dsh-lan-access README · Notes：- The bind host is pinned to `0.0.0.0` by this plugin's patch; edit
  `cordis.patch.yml` if you need a different posture.
- `--port` still works (the patch keeps the `!!js` port expression).
- By default privileged `/api` methods (settings/credentials/agent presets)
  are reachable from trusted LAN hosts (`allowRemotePrivileged: true`); set
  `config: { allowRemotePrivileged: false }` on the `lan-access` row to
  restore loopback-only for them.
- Uninstall: `dsh plugin --profile web remove @woyeshishen/dsh-lan-access`
- This plugin intentionally exposes a remote-code-execution surface to the
  network — only use it on a trusted LAN.
